question: Tα CD4 + lymphocytes:

options.opa: They are functionally cooperative with B lymphocytes and other T lymphocytes.
options.opb: They recognize native antigens in soluble form.
options.opc: They recognize peptides in the MHC class I context.
options.opd: They are less abundant than CD8 + in human blood.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Tαβ CD4 + lymphocytes -> functionally cooperative with B lymphocytes and other T lymphocytes -> 80% CHAIN: Tαβ CD4 + lymphocytes -> recognize native antigens in soluble form -> 70% CHAIN: Tαβ CD4 + lymphocytes -> recognize peptides in the MHC class I context -> 60% CHAIN: Tαβ CD4 + lymphocytes -> less abundant than CD8 + in human blood -> 90% CHAIN: Tαβ CD4 + lymphocytes -> release perforins -> possible, -> 80%
analysis: Tα CD4 + lymphocytes are primarily involved in helping B lymphocytes produce antibodies and activating other immune cells. They recognize antigens presented by MHC class II molecules. They are more abundant than CD8 + lymphocytes in human blood. They do not release perforins.
